---
title: "{{TITLE}}"
subtitle: "Lecture {{N}}"
author: "Tyler Sotomayor"

# ————— chapter opener —————
# The PDF partials in ../_pdf read these; the HTML opener derives the lecture
# kicker from `subtitle` and the course from the navbar title.
kicker: "Lecture {{N}}"
course: "Local Projections: From First Principles to Empirical Research"
contents-label: "Contents of this lecture"
solutions-companion: true

number-sections: true
toc-depth: 3

# Figure titles sit above the figure, in small caps, as in the handbook.
fig-cap-location: top
# In-text citations link to their bibliography entry in both formats.
link-citations: true

execute:
  freeze: true
  echo: false
  warning: false
filters:
  - ../../filters/course-apparatus.lua
css:
  - ../notes-ebook.css
format:
  html:
    include-after-body: ../notes-chapter.html
  pdf:
    documentclass: article
    fig-pos: H
    geometry:
      - letterpaper
      - top=1in
      - bottom=1in
      - left=1.15in
      - right=1in
      - headheight=14pt
    toc: false          # the contents strip is part of the opener instead
    colorlinks: true
    number-sections: true
    template-partials:
      - ../_pdf/title.tex
      - ../_pdf/before-body.tex
    include-in-header:
      - ../_pdf/handbook.tex
format-links: [pdf]
bibliography: references.bib
csl: ../lp-apa.csl
---

```{=latex}
\clearpage
```
